quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The safest speed for a residential area.
The safest speed for leaving an expressway.
The safest speed for entering an expressway.
The safest speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safest speed for leaving an expressway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed for an expressway exit. In this example, it shows 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and let others go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others go if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others go if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach an intersection with this sign and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for road workers.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction and maintenance. This sign tells drivers that road work is ahead and they should slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of cattle that may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road has many turns and curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road has many turns and curves.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers in the left lane must turn left.
Turn left only when the arrow is green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers in the left lane must turn left.
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign means there is a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead. Stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. This sign warns that wet pavement makes the road slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Cars turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cars turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass. Left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows rules drivers must follow. Right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in this work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to road conditions and hazards ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns of low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
A divided highway is starting. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. Drivers should slow down to the safe speed indicated on the sign, which is 35 mph in this case.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to road conditions and hazards ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells drivers that a railroad crossing is ahead and they should watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates the road ahead is now a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that buggies may be ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign tells you to drive carefully when the road is wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers from both directions that they can use the center lane only to turn left. Do not use this lane for regular driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit sign show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the fastest you can legally drive. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit depending on weather and road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a playground is near and to watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you can either turn right or drive straight ahead from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn about construction zones. This sign tells you that penalties for unsafe driving are doubled in work zones.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic pass before you enter the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is coming from both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this stop sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a complete stop and go when safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on crossing roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and go when safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. You must yield to vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection. Go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that traffic is coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are only for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are only for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: A driver extends their left arm downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, they are signaling that they will stop. If you are following them, be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Cars from entering full parking lots.
Cars from entering road construction areas.
Cars from entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cars from entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in one direction only. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign alerts you that the shoulder ahead is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that you will encounter a detour in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that the divided highway will end soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. They show rules that drivers must follow. This sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. They show rules that drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead has loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead has loose gravel.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you the road surface ahead is loose gravel. Drive carefully because your tires will not grip the road as well on gravel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about hazards in construction zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about hazards in construction zones. This sign directs you to take a different route because of roadwork ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells drivers that the road will soon become a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right because of roadwork.
Slow down because the road curves sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road curves sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves sharply. Slow down as much as you would when turning at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at traffic lights where you cannot turn right on a red light. You must follow this rule.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used for no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to stay on the right side to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be present in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for workers on or near the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for workers on or near the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road. Drive slowly and carefully in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about dangers. This sign means a flagger is ahead and will direct traffic. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow the detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main road if you can.
Follow the detour to the right only if it is convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Orange work area signs show an alternate route around a closed road. Follow the detour signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means there are several left turn lanes. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means you should watch carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means no. Right turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for a sharp left turn.
Take the detour to avoid unsafe driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take the detour to avoid unsafe driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the traffic pattern or route has changed due to construction. Follow the detour.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn about hazards. This sign means workers may be on or near the road. Drive with extra caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is entering from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you about road conditions ahead. It tells you a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic is approaching from the left.
Right lane ends ahead, merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead, merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending. You must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the slowest speed you are allowed to drive. Do not drive slower than the speed shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This white rectangular sign with black markings is a rule you must follow. Where this sign is posted, you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will make a sharp turn to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill slope is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a road crossing is coming up. Watch carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers how they must behave. You can park here for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that railroad tracks are ahead. Slow down when you approach them. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must let them pass first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop at an intersection. Let other traffic pass first. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black lettering or symbols. They tell you about hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that another road meets this one ahead from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a sharp right turn coming up on the road.

questions.question: What should you be most concerned about when you see this sign?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This could cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with the flow of traffic.
Slow down for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The maximum speed is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the fastest speed you are allowed to drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is coming. The road splits into two separate one-way roads. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign warns you that a bridge with narrow lanes is coming. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road curves back and forth. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead makes a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A 35 mph speed zone begins after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph around the curve ahead.
A curve is ahead. Speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve is ahead. Speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a curve ahead. It shows that 35 mph is the recommended safe speed for the curve.

questions.question: You see this sign above your lane. What must you do?

options.text: You can either continue or exit from your lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue through.
You must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane leads to an exit ramp. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to prevent traffic congestion.
Change lanes if safe to let traffic merge in.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes if safe to let traffic merge in.
questions.explanation: Make room for vehicles entering the freeway. If possible, move to another lane to help traffic merge safely.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and crossing traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and crossing traffic.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is eight-sided. You must stop completely and check for pedestrians and other traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
Certain turns are allowed from certain lanes only.
Drivers in both lanes must merge carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. It is reserved for buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must or must not do. Large trucks are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones ahead. This sign alerts you that you will need to follow a different route because of construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An extra lane is being added.

questions.correctAnswerText: An extra lane is being added.
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. They are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that an extra lane is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead only allows one-way traffic.
The bridge ahead can only fit one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass or meet a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass or meet a truck.
questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with black markings. It warns you that a narrow bridge is coming up. You may not have enough space to safely pass or meet a truck.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must or must not do. It marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must do or not do. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a caution sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is always at the top and green is always at the bottom. On horizontal lights, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead has a series of curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden stops or turns, and keep more distance from the car ahead when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign tells you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A regulation sign with a red circle and red slash means an action is not allowed. U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The road ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road curves to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that a traffic light is ahead. Be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that parking is not allowed here. Regulation signs show rules that drivers must follow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to wait for the left turn signal before turning left. It is safe to turn left only when the signal allows it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that farm machinery may be driving on the road ahead. Warning signs are yellow with black markings.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. Low vehicles may get stuck or drag on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Keep your current speed until you reach the reduced speed zone.
